steps: Gather ingredients for TWO servings. Wash vegetables; Slice chicken into bite-size pieces and pat dry.
Heat oven to 220°C. Toss potatoes/vegetables with half the oil, salt and pepper, and roast 20-25 minutes until tender.
Mix your added seasonings with 2 tbsp water, and adjust acidity and salt to taste.
Cook chicken in a hot skillet with a little oil for about 6-9 minutes, turning until the centre reaches 74°C.
Cook any remaining vegetables in the same pan for 3-5 minutes until crisp-tender. Add sauce; simmer briefly until it lightly coats the protein.
Assemble and divide into 2 plates. Add fresh herbs, citrus or toppings if listed. Taste and adjust seasoning. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
halal: Buy halal-certified chicken; Use alcohol-free soy sauce and sauces; verify broth, cheese rennet and packaged condiments. Never assume HelloFresh-branded sauces are halal.

title: Super Quick Tagine-Inspired Beef Stew

ingredients.name: halal lean ground beef or sliced steak

steps: Gather ingredients for TWO servings. Wash vegetables; Slice steak thinly against the grain, or break up ground beef into small pieces.
Cook onion in oil 3-4 minutes, add garlic and dry spices for 30 seconds, then add tomatoes and water or halal broth.
Mix your added seasonings with 2 tbsp water, and adjust acidity and salt to taste.
Brown ground beef for 7-9 minutes until fully cooked (71°C); for steak, sear to your preferred safe doneness.
Add cooked protein to the simmering tomato/broth base, along with any vegetables. Simmer 8-12 minutes until tender and the sauce has thickened.
Assemble and divide into 2 plates. Add fresh herbs, citrus or toppings if listed. Taste and adjust seasoning. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
